proposals.proponent: Legal & General Investment Management America, Inc. ("LGIM America")
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board adopt a policy and amend bylaws so the Chair of the Board is, whenever possible, an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.

proposals.title: Proposal to Publish an Annual Report Disclosing Lobbying Activities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and model-legislation organization payments, and board decision-making oversight.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Disclose Lobbying Activities and Alignment with Public Policy Positions and Statements
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party review of whether Lilly's direct and trade association lobbying aligns with its public policy positions, and how misaligned lobbying risks are addressed.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Report Oversight of Risks Related to Anticompetitive Pricing Strategies
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on how the board oversees risks related to anticompetitive practices, including board committee responsibility, strategy deliberations, and public policy activities.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
